basic_profile.bio: An aspiring game designer from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for 3D modeling and community-driven projects. I spend most of my free time collaborating with others on fanmade initiatives, especially around gaming maps and design. I am a night owl, typically online from 9 PM to 2 AM PST. By day, I work as a junior graphic designer at a local agency. In a relationship with my high school sweetheart. I enjoy photography and aerial acrobatics, often combining the two with my Lumix camera and aerial hoop performances.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital arts, having completed a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design. I've been self-teaching 3D modeling and game design through online tutorials and community forums. My expertise is further honed by participating in collaborative projects and engaging with online communities centered around fanmade content.
